address: Grand Hôtel Henri, 1 cours René-Char, L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue, 84800, France
bio: The restaurant of the Grand Hôtel Henri is in the extension just off the main hotel building. It has a beautiful decor with a fireplace dating back a century and sparkling chandeliers. There is a terrace shaded by mulberry plane trees with a fountain, as well as lovely seasonal cuisine with a focus on regional flavours. Very good value for money at lunch...
